business_summary: Hatcher Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides financial services in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and Canada. It offers corporate finance advisory services, such as acting as financial adviser in transactions or compliance matters under the rules governing the listing of securities on the stock exchange, the GEM listing rules, and/or the codes on takeovers and mergers and share buy-backs; independent financial adviser to the independent board committees and shareholders of listed companies; sponsor in initial public offerings (IPO) exercises; advising companies on compliance requirements; and compliance adviser to listed companies post-IPO. The company also provides placing and underwriting services by acting as underwriter, sub-underwriter, placing agent, or sub-placing agent in fund raising, as well as assists companies listed or to be listed on the stock exchange in securing investors. In addition, it offers business consulting services for individuals and/or entities; assists customers in enhancing and transforming business performance through strategic and operational re-engineering; and provides margin enhancement, finance functions and process enhancement, post-merger integration, cost optimization, and performance measurement services, as well as asset management services, such as advisory services for equity securities, fixed income securities, real estate securities, mutual funds, and portfolio management services for professional clients; and corporate secretarial, accounting and taxation, risk management, and internal control advisory services. The company was formerly known as VBG International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Hatcher Group Limited in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Taikoo Shing, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Hatcher Group Limited는 홍콩, 중국 및 캐나다에서 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권 거래소의 유가 증권 상장, GEM 상장 규칙 및/또는 인수, 합병 및 주식 환매에 관한 규정에 따라 거래 또는 규정 준수 문제에서 금융 자문 역할을 하는 등 기업 금융 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 상장회사의 독립 이사회 위원회 및 주주에 대한 독립 재무 자문가; 기업공개(IPO) 활동 후원 규정 준수 요구 사항에 대해 회사에 조언 IPO 이후 상장 기업에 대한 규정 준수 고문이기도 합니다. 또한 회사는 자금 조달에서 인수인, 하위 인수인, 발행 대리인 또는 대체 대리인 역할을 하여 발행 및 인수 서비스를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 증권 거래소에 상장되거나 상장 예정인 기업이 투자자를 확보할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 또한 개인 및/또는 법인을 위한 비즈니스 컨설팅 서비스도 제공합니다. 전략 및 운영 리엔지니어링을 통해 고객이 비즈니스 성과를 향상하고 변화시킬 수 있도록 지원합니다. 마진 강화, 재무 기능 및 프로세스를 제공합니다.
